name: first_hour_range_breakout_v1
mechanism: NIFTY's first trading hour (09:15-10:15) absorbs overnight information, FII pre-positioning, and opening auction imbalances, forming a well-anchored high-low range. Many institutional TWAP algorithms and bracket-order participants set stop-losses just outside this range. When NIFTY closes above the first-hour high (or below the low) with elevated volume post-10:15, it triggers a cascade of stop-loss orders and directional VWAP algorithms that had been range-bound, creating a 20-35 spot point momentum burst in the first 30-90 seconds. We enter at the second consecutive close above/below the range level — this filters 5-second spikes — and ride the initial cascade momentum rather than the full multi-hour continuation.
core_signal_oneliner: Two consecutive 5s closes outside the first-hour range (09:15-10:15) with volume > 1.3x average and VWAP alignment, triggering stop-cascade momentum
